difficulty_reason: Hypothesis check that makes the affine-etale comparison functor well defined: (1) holds by definition of X_affine, (2) is reduced through the slice equivalence X_affine_etale/x = (Aff/U)_etale compatible with structure sheaves to the scheme-level assertion that the total cohomology complex of a complex of R-modules on (Aff/U)_etale is quasi-isomorphic to the original complex, which is then settled by the matching-total-direct-images remark and the etale-cohomology comparison lemma. Retained author proof at lines 4970-4994.
